reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added an experimental feature to enable lazily create subset of Envoy staistics", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Envoy statistics are now created lazily by default, which saves memory and CPU cycles when stats are not referenced; the previous behavior of creating all statistics upfront can be restored by setting ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION to false.

proposed.statement: An experimental environment variable ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION was added to the agent Deployment to control lazy creation of Envoy statistics; the feature is enabled by default and can be disabled by setting it to false.
